metric: Data return rate and diagnostic yield of Apple Watch ECG monitoring in a rare-disease cohort
result: >95% data return rate over 8 weeks; 2/5 participants showed ventricular ectopic beats; the single watch 'alert' ECG returned was read as normal sinus rhythm (possible false positive).

metric: Qualitative user-experience evaluation of an explainable-AI prototype by cardiologists
result: Progressive web app prototype received above-average user experience evaluations from cardiologists in a 3-stage co-design/pilot process; no numeric score reported.
Abstract not available; title indicates a critical literature review with meta-analysis of AI algorithms screening for left ventricular hypertrophy on 12-lead ECG. No extractable data.

metric: Feasibility, acceptability, appropriateness and usability (System Usability Scale) of remote postpartum monitoring
result: Rated feasible 93%, acceptable 93%, appropriate 92%, usable 80% (SUS); remote monitoring detected 60% of women with BP >140/90 mmHg in the first 2 postpartum weeks.

PRISMA-ScR scoping review of 11 studies (of 1186 screened) on wearables for long COVID; 10 different devices identified (4 FDA-approved) covering HRV, temperature, sleep and activity; narrative synthesis without a single comparable usability/performance figure.
Abstract not available; title indicates advanced ECG analysis of multimodal exercise effects on cardiovascular health. No extractable data.

metric: Clinical, paraclinical and therapeutic profile of NSTEMI patients
result: Retrospective single-center cohort of 140 NSTEMI patients; in-hospital mortality 3%; clinical epidemiology study, not a software study.
Human-robot collaboration study on robot appearance/voice effects on user perception, using ECG/GSR/eye-tracking as physiological measures; not a cardiology software study.

metric: Classification of true vs. false crisis alarms in cardiopulmonary monitoring
result: Among crisis alarms reviewed, 11 true ventricular tachycardia and 11 true asystole alarms were identified; a high number of false alarms attributed to artifacts and low QRS voltage.

metric: Machine-learning classification accuracy for emotion recognition from multimodal physiological signals
result: ML models reached 80%, 85% and 70% accuracy for arousal, valence and 4-class emotion classification respectively; ECG used only as one of several affective-computing signals, not a cardiology software study.
Cohort analysis (ADVANCE study) of male British combat veterans finding lower HRV (RMSSD) associated with higher central augmentation index; physiological association study, not a software study.

Describes ValsalvaAnalyzer, a MATLAB GUI software combining signal processing and modeling to extract over 35 HR/BP biomarkers from Valsalva maneuver data; no user-study or performance metrics reported in the abstract.

metric: Machine-learning accuracy for classifying pain type from multimodal physiological signals
result: ML classifiers reached 0.82 accuracy for social pain and 0.90 for physical pain vs. baseline; 0.63-0.77 accuracy distinguishing pain types; ECG used only as one of several signals, not a cardiology software study.

metric: Electrode noise performance of a contactless in-bed ECG/HRV sensing system
result: Flexible active electrodes achieved 64 dB noise reduction via double active shielding, with input-referred noise of 0.49 uV (abstract truncated before further results).
